findings.evidence: docs/internal/product/backlog.md line 59 (`grep -n "^| M2\." docs/internal/product/backlog.md`) reads `| M2.28 | ADR-0019 + re-plan: ... | ... | todo |` while M2.29-M2.34 immediately below it all read `done`; `git log --oneline -- docs/internal/product/backlog.md` shows the row was written `todo` by cc5e298 (M2.28's own commit) and never revisited by any of the following six commits. Compare against sdd.md's 'A row is terse, and a `done` row is frozen' and next-task/SKILL.md's 'take the top unblocked task'.
findings.summary: Backlog row M2.28 is still marked `todo` although its commit (cc5e298) is on main, ADR-0019 is accepted, and all six downstream tasks that build on it (M2.29-M2.34) already read `done` -- violating the file's own 'a `done` row is frozen'/'rows reflect reality' convention and leaving a `next-task` read of the top-unblocked-task pointing at already-finished work. Resolved directly in this commit: M2.28's row is flipped to `done` (all downstream work was already done; the row itself was the only stale artifact).
